title: Arizer Extreme Q Glass Heater Cover Kit
description:
Restore your Arizer Extreme Q or V-Tower vaporizer with the Glass Heater Cover Kit! Designed for easy DIY repairs, this kit includes everything needed to replace a broken glass heater cover. Perfectly compatible with both Extreme Q and V-Tower models, it ensures seamless functionality and prolonged vaporizer life. Full instructions are included for hassle-free installation, but if you prefer professional assistance, simply contact us for repair services.

Keep your vaporizers performing at their best with this essential replacement part. Shop now and enjoy uninterrupted sessions with your Arizer Extreme Q and V-Tower!
